title: Member (Judicial) and Member (Technical)
organization: Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT)
summary: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad has invited applications from willing and eligible Judicial Officers for selection to the posts of Member (Judicial) and Member (Technical) in Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT).
eligibility_bullets: Open to willing and eligible Judicial Officers who have retired or are going to retire within the next six months i.e. upto 31.05.2027.
how_to_apply_steps: Obtain application/bio-data in the prescribed proforma.
Submit the application along with required details to the Court by 05.12.2026 for further necessary action.
